title: NEUROSYNC Protocol: Multimodal Auditory Stimulation Under Chromatic Ambient Lighting
author: Puneet Tomar

steps.title: Prepare the environment
steps.instruction: Set the room to the assigned chromatic ambient lighting condition (red or blue), ensuring artificial lighting is the dominant visual exposure.

steps.title: Prepare the participant station
steps.instruction: Open the NEUROSYNC start page and verify internet access for embedded Google Forms and headphone playback.

steps.title: Prepare recording systems
steps.instruction: Prepare the Muse S EEG device, Empatica EmbracePlus wearable, and CZUR Halo webcam, ensuring the webcam faces the seated participant.

steps.title: Prepare the session log
steps.instruction: Open the session log to record start times, stop times, restarts, interruptions, survey delays, shortened acclimation, and sensor-quality notes.

steps.title: Confirm consent and identity
steps.instruction: Confirm electronic consent (including video recording), the participant identifier, and the assigned lighting condition.

steps.title: Seat and fit participant
steps.instruction: Seat the participant at the test station and fit the wearable devices.

steps.title: Start external recordings
steps.instruction: Start EEG, peripheral physiology, and participant-facing video recording before the browser-guided sequence begins.

steps.title: Initiate platform sequence
steps.instruction: Navigate through the initial platform pages with the participant.

substeps.instruction: Display platform homepage and confirm readiness.

steps.title: Perform acclimation
steps.instruction: Allow the session environment to stabilize while the participant settles into a comfortable posture and looks forward.

steps.title: Run resting baseline
steps.instruction: Run the eyes-open resting baseline for 300 seconds while external recordings continue.

steps.title: Execute Task Block 1
steps.instruction: Run the first task block with continuous 10 Hz auditory stimulation.

substeps.instruction: Run 10 verbal-semantic items at 60 seconds each.
Participants select from: 'there was an inconsistency in the sentence', 'there was no inconsistency in the sentence', or 'there was an inconsistency in the sentence but it was corrected'.

steps.title: Administer first post-task survey
steps.instruction: Keep the embedded post-task survey form open until submitted. The survey covers task difficulty, alertness/relaxation, emotional stability, engagement, focus, cognitive load, emotional valence/arousal, and indoor-environment perception/satisfaction.

steps.title: Execute Task Block 2
steps.instruction: Run the second task block with continuous 40 Hz auditory stimulation.

substeps.instruction: Run 10 visuospatial illusion items at 60 seconds each.
Participants select from: 'I solved the puzzle', 'I could not solve the puzzle', or 'I am not sure whether there is a solution'.

steps.title: Administer second post-task survey
steps.instruction: Keep the embedded post-task survey form open until submitted.

steps.title: Close the session
steps.instruction: End the session and transition back to the operator.

substeps.instruction: Hand session back to operator for completion and debriefing.

steps.title: Secure and log data
steps.instruction: Verify and preserve all recorded data and session metadata.

substeps.instruction: Confirm capture of survey timestamps, EEG, peripheral physiology, and participant-facing video files.
Log restarts, shortened acclimation, delayed surveys, platform crashes, incomplete recordings, or channel-quality issues.
Preserve actual session start/end timestamps and operator notes for retrospective alignment of browser stages, survey timestamps, and recorded modalities.
